IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators Keiser and Brandland; by request of Department of Social and Health Services

IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Health & Long-Term Care.

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of social and health services to defend temporary managers in nursing homes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to indemnifying and defending department of socialand health services appointed temporary managers in nursing homes; andadding a new section to chapter 18.51 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.51 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless anytemporary manager appointed and acting under RCW 18.51.060(7) againstclaims made against the temporary manager for any actions by thetemporary manager or its agents that do not amount to intentional tortsor criminal behavior.
